Belur.desc: The site of the 12th-century Chennakeshava Temple, one of the finest examples of Hoysala architecture, built in soapstone with intricate carvings. It is on the Bengaluru–Chikmagalur–Hassan circuit, a couple of hours from Halebidu. (sourced from r/karnataka heritage threads)
